BOTS.TITLE: Workflows
BOTS.DESCRIPTION: Design conversation flows that answer, qualify, and route — then publish them to any inbox.
BOTS.CREATE_DIALOG_DESCRIPTION: You can change this later. The editor opens in a new tab.
BOTS.DELETE_CONFIRM: This will remove the flow and unassign it from every inbox. This cannot be undone.
BOTS.ASSIGN_SUCCESS: Assigned. The workflow will handle new conversations.
BOTS.ASSIGN_ERROR: Failed to assign workflow. Publish it first.
BOTS.UNASSIGN_ERROR: Failed to remove workflow from inbox.
BOTS.EMPTY_SUBTITLE: Create your first automated flow. You can test it in a chat preview before publishing.
BOTS.NOT_CONFIGURED_HELP: Set TYPEBOT_BUILDER_URL and TYPEBOT_API_TOKEN on the server, then redeploy.
BOTS.POPUP_BLOCKED: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
BOTS.BUILDER_URL_MISSING: TYPEBOT_BUILDER_URL is not set on the server.
